name: Moped
description: A passenger vehicle on two or three wheels, with or without pedals (cyclomoteur), with an electric motor or one of 50 cm³ or less and an automatic transmission, and a top speed of 70 km/h; an electric scooter past the e-bike's 500 W or 32 km/h but within that speed lands here, with no limit on motor power.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, an electric motor or one of 50 cm³ or less, an automatic transmission, and a top speed of 70 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 4

restrictions.rule: No limit on an electric motor's power, but no one may sell parts that raise a moped's power or speed past what its manufacturer built
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 4, 274.3

restrictions.rule: A road vehicle: must be registered with the SAAQ
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 4, 6

restrictions.rule: Bears a Transport Canada compliance label and a 17-character VIN as built to the federal motor vehicle safety standards
Riders need a class 6D moped licence, from age 14 after the SAAQ's training course and exams; a class 5 driver's licence includes it
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 67; Regulation respecting licences, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 34, ss. 28.11, 29, 35.0.1

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle helmet, and the rider needs eye protection without a visor where the limit is over 50 km/h
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 484; Protective Helmets Regulation, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 6, s. 2

restrictions.rule: The headlight must be on at all times, and it needs a mirror on each side
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 263, 482

restrictions.rule: Carries a passenger only on a fixed seat with footrests on each side, and never with a rider under 16
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, ss. 480, 480.1

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on limited-access highways or their entrance and exit ramps
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 479

restrictions.rule: Can't ride between lanes of moving traffic or between a vehicle and the edge of the road
restrictions.citation: Highway Safety Code, CQLR c C-24.2, s. 478

restrictions.rule: One that looks like a moped but lacks a federal compliance label or a US or Mexican safety certification mark is banned from public highways if it has footrests or a platform, moped-style wheels and tires, a body covering its frame with no height-adjustable saddle, or a motor able to exceed 32 km/h or 500 W
restrictions.citation: Ministerial Order 2024-24, CQLR c C-24.2, r. 0.1.3, ss. 1, 2
